blind.description: A small oval medallion or relief mask consisting of a sculpted golden human face wearing a striped red-and-gold headband, mounted onto a dark bronze or wooden backing disc. The object stands vertically upright on its thin edge without an easel or stand. The surfaces are smooth, continuous, and fully intact.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal edge-on oval with a rounded central relief bump pointing downward, casting an oval shadow to the upper-left.
defects: balanced upright on its thin rim or hovering without a stand
blind.height_vs_figure: about 10 to 12 inches in diameter, roughly one-sixth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure

match.reads_as: gold face mask mounted on an oval plaque
